The '''HP&nbsp;33s''' (F2216A) was a [[scientific calculator]] marketed by [[Hewlett-Packard]]. It was introduced in 2003 as the successor to the [[HP&nbsp;32SII]],<ref name=hidalgo /> and discontinued on the introduction of its successor, the [[HP&nbsp;35s]] in 2007.

==Features==
Its main features are:
* [[Reverse Polish Notation|RPN]] or traditional semi-algebraic (infix data/algebraic operator entry/postfix one-number function entry), user-selectable
* Two-line LCD
* Full scientific/engineering mathematical features
* [[Keystroke programming|Keystroke-programmable]] with full [[boolean algebra|boolean]] and program-control command sets and line edit, insert and delete
* HP "equation list" equation editor (fully algebraic) in both the stand-alone list as well as in keystroke programs
* HP&nbsp;Solver feature (solves equations and functions for one unknown)
* Function [[integral|integration]] feature
* All mathematical operations and features fully functional in all modes
* Unit conversion and constants
* 31&nbsp;[[kilobyte|KB]] of [[random-access memory|random-access user memory]] (equivalent to about 7&nbsp;KB on earlier HP programmable models)

The main differences from the HP&nbsp;32SII are:
* A radical difference in keypad layout and appearance
* Memory is expanded from 2&nbsp;KB to 32&nbsp;KB
* Faster processor
* More functions
* Algebraic entry mode as well as RPN
* The display has two lines
* The length of an equation was now restricted to 255 characters (no arbitrary limit in the 32SII)<ref name=hidalgo />

The HP&nbsp;33s was co-designed and manufactured by [[Kinpo Electronics]] of [[Taiwan]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.kinpo.com.tw/English/product_consumer_1.html|title=Consumer Electronics: Calculator|publisher=Kinpo Electronics|accessdate=2013-07-11}}</ref>

==Reception==
The HP 33s is generally considered to have fewer logic [[software bug|bugs]] than the [[HP&nbsp;35s]]. However, the unconventional [[chevron (insignia)|chevron]]-styled keypad has been regarded by reviewers as bizarre and difficult to use compared to other HP professional calculators.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.thimet.de/CalcCollection/Calculators/HP-33S/Contents.htm|title=HP&nbsp;33s|author=Tony Thimet|accessdate=2013-07-11}}</ref><ref name=hidalgo>{{cite web|url=http://www.hpcc.org/datafile/V23N3/33S.pdf|title=Summing up the HP&nbsp;33s|author=Jordi Hidalgo|publisher=Handheld and Portable Computer Club|format=pdf|accessdate=2013-07-11}}</ref>

==Revisions==
The 33s went through numerous revisions that have solved two of the most pervasive issues people had with the early models (namely poor screen quality and bad keypad responsiveness).
